_about: Default booking & cancellation policy settings. All editable in Settings > Policies. See docs/SPEC.md section 4 for behavior.
_savedPaymentMethodNote: optional = clients may pay with Zelle, Venmo, Cash App, Apple Cash, PayPal.Me or cash instead of saving a card/wallet. Without a saved method, any required deposit must be received before the booking is confirmed, and late-cancel/no-show fees become a balance owed (payment request sent). required = every booking needs a saved card, Google Pay, Apple Pay or Cash App Pay.

newClient._note: Deposit for new clients. Can be turned on for any service category. Amount is always capped at the estimated total of the booked services (a $30 haircut never asks for more than $30).

flaggedClient._note: Clients with an active flag pay the full estimated price of all booked services up front.

flags._note: A flag stays active until the client completes N on-time visits after it (default 4). Flags marked permanent never clear. Every flag stays in the client's violation history forever, and past violations always trigger a warning when the client books.

lateCancel._note: autoCharge true = charge immediately; false = hold for the stylist's one-tap approval.

noShow._note: No-show is marked by the stylist, so the charge sheet always opens with Full preselected.
